How the floor comes back

01

Walk-through

You point. We mark the keep-pile with blue tape. Nothing moves without your say-so.

02

Carry-out

Dollies, gloves, padded straps. Walls and floors stay as we found them.

03

Sort

Donate, recycle, landfill — sorted at the truck, not dumped in a pile.

04

Load

Strapped tight so nothing shifts on the drive to the transfer station.

05

Sweep

Broom-clean slab. You can park in it that night.

06

Sign-off

You walk the empty space with us. If something's off, we come back that week.

What we clear

Garage cleanouts

Everything you point at comes out, and the slab gets swept so the car fits again.

Storm debris removal

Wet carpet, drywall, screens and fence panels hauled off after a hurricane or a flood.

Furniture removal

Sofas, recliners, dressers and beds carried out by our crew, down stairs and elevators.

Appliance removal

Old fridges, chest freezers and washers taken away, with the refrigerant handled properly.

Condo and seasonal home cleanouts

Snowbird condos cleared through the elevator, with the hallway and lobby left as we found them.

Estate cleanouts

A whole house cleared room by room, with a keep pile the crew never touches.

Hot tub removal

Dead spas cut down on the lanai or the slab and carried out through the side gate.

Yard waste removal

Palm fronds, branches and old landscape timbers bagged and hauled, no matter the pile size.

Mattress removal

Old mattresses and box springs out of the bedroom and off to the recycler.

Donation drop-off

Furniture and boxes in good shape go to local donation centres before anything is dumped.

Where it goes

Not everything is trash. Here's how we sort.

Likely donate

Furniture with no tears and no pet hair usually finds a new home.

Likely recycle

Metal, cardboard and clean yard waste stay out of the landfill.

Landfill last

Wet drywall, broken glass and mixed junk go to the transfer station.
